newsitem.title: FINLAND: MARKKA BONDS UP WITH BUNDS, EYES ON U.S. DATA.
newsitem.headline: MARKKA BONDS UP WITH BUNDS, EYES ON U.S. DATA.

text.p: on Wednesday, working to keep up with strong trend in Bunds, but
the market remained edgy ahead of U.S. industrial production
"Germany has strengthened quite a bit, and we have been
following," one market analyst said, but added that volumes were
Most of the trade was in the long end of the curve, both in
the 2006 bond and in the 2006 future, dealers said.
Views were mixed on whether strong U.S. data could turn the
trend in Europe, with some saying Germany would remain firm.
"The basic trend in Germany is strong. The figures (from the U.S.) would have to be very bad to turn the trend, and we are following Germany," one analyst said.
But others said the Bund rally could be fragile after strong gains yesterday.
The spread to Germany was seen staying within 50 basis points.
The markka recovered from early weakness generated by markka selling, with DEM/FIM sticking around 3.00 and seen trading there, forex dealers said.
